newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends steady despite sharp NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends steady despite sharp NYMEX rally.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices, shrugging off a sharp rise in NYMEX futures contracts, ended steady on Tuesday in quiet activity ahead of a round of European holidays this week, traders said.
No cargo deals were heard done but shipping sources said Texaco and G.E. Warren each fixed a 60,000 tonne clean tanker out of Europe for mid-May loading and headed for the U.S. Atlantic Coast.
Eurograde barges ended down $1 at $195/$197 fob ARA after a Scandanavian trader bought this morning at $196 and a major was a buyer of refinery material later at $195, sources said.
"It's very quiet and from a very simplistic viewpoint there are more sellers than buyers," said one broker, when asked his forecast on the market.
Eurograde cargoes were notionally set at $201/$203 cif with regular unleaded holding unchanged at $194/$198.
A 60,000 tonne cargo was sold on Monday into the States for loading May 10-15 at a price of 6.30 cents below the screen, he said.
Traders were also awaiting weekly American Petroleum Institute data due out after the NYMEX close.
